derivedFrom: New release. Tool-surface reference: https://github.com/ZacharyZcR/vmware-mcp (21 of its 54 vmrun-named tools; no code copied, and that repository carries no LICENSE file).
releaseScope: A zero-dependency Node 24 stdio MCP server that controls VMware Workstation through vmrun: power/status, guest operations, clone and host-network port forwarding. The recipe follows the software repository's ai-software/v1 shape; vmrest, vmcli and snapshot tools are out of scope.
changes: src/server.mjs: newline-delimited JSON-RPC over stdio (initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call)
src/lib/tools.mjs: 21 fixed vmrun tools; no shell and no arbitrary argv passthrough
src/lib/policy.mjs: VMWARE_VMX_ROOTS containment, VMWARE_WORKSPACE_ROOT containment, confirm gates, read-only switch
src/lib/vmrun.mjs: execFile argv execution, timeouts, guest credential redaction
tests: protocol, policy/argv rendering, live read-only smoke and safety gates
unchanged: No published release was modified; this is the first release of software/VMware
software/registry.json was not edited (shared-side change; proposed entry is documented in README.md)
openDeferred: software/registry.json entry: intentionally not applied without a separate shared-side approval
Guest-auth live calls (vmrun_run/ps/kill/file_exists/copy) were gate-tested but not executed: no guest credentials were supplied
Real clone and port-forwarding writes were argv/confirm tested but not executed: no disposable target was supplied
vmrest (20 REST tools) and vmcli (43 tools) are not implemented; vmcli.exe is absent from Workstation 17.5.2 on this host
Snapshot tools are not in this release (user scope excluded them)
Guest passwords are passed to vmrun with -gp and therefore appear in the local process list; this is a vmrun limitation documented in README.md
pointerPolicy: VMware/current.json created at 1.0.0; available lists only 1.0.0
